author: Thomas Impelluso
text_post: Initially, I was irritated with her new song: Rule the World (Girls). If a male singer was to perform these lyrics, it would be sexist.   So, apparently, she has blinded herself to equity. Aside from that, the women in the video all pamper themselves with make up so one wonders how they have time to rule the world. In a nutshell, I think she is pandering to feminism (and with ignorant arrogance to boot).  And when people rise to a level of such arrogance and ignorance, they are bound to lose sight of what is proper. So I am not surprised by the current controversy in which she sampled transmissions from the Challenger disaster.   http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/beyonce-slammed-sampling-shuttle-tragedy-album/story?id=21365376 It seems that when one blinds oneself, one steps over the line.  Intersting to watch the monster now devour her as she hides behind apologies.  She does not seem to be such a good world-ruler, after all.
